contribution_boundaries.independently_reviewed: Frozen source, expected observations, freeze record, acceptance runner and native/browser checker were authored by root/recovery. This reviewer authored admission/parser documentation and later GLB callback fixes, not these checked inputs or the checker. The reviewer later authored the construction adapter repair; it too is excluded from this independent frozen-input/checker approval.
contribution_boundaries.new_execution: Static exact-rational source rederivation only; no OntoKin import/evaluation/export, checker execution, browser launch or screenshot review.

assessments.physics: Six initially resting 2 kg spheres receive 2 N in +Y for two seconds, so ay=1; 4 N*s at t=1 gives delta_vx=2. Therefore x=x0+2 max(t-1,0), y=t^2/2 through t=2 then 2+2(t-2), z=0. Center impulses and center forces add no spin; every frozen quaternion is identity. The visual local +0.1 Z placement is not a physical carrier translation.
assessments.geometry: The checker derives +Z elliptical rings from authored section stations, centers and radii, creates the specified outward two-triangle side pattern and opposite cap fans, applies the source local placement, and checks every actual decoded triangle with orientation and region preserved. Lower-station side regions and endpoint cap regions give 48 clay and 48 paint triangles per vessel. Actual decoded RGBA, metallic and roughness factors are compared.
assessments.byte_consumption: Khronos and native Three.js consume the supplied file bytes. The checker validates explicit target/profile/schema, flat node inventory, actual source-manifest revision and frozen entry hash, then decodes mesh buffers and animation. Expected poses remain in the controlling process; the browser receives artifact bytes and requested observation times only. Artifact/expected hashes are recorded and reread before success.
assessments.native_and_browser: Native Three.js checks geometry/PBR and 78 actual sampled poses. Browser Three.js independently loads the same supplied bytes, returns 78 actual AnimationMixer poses for comparison, renders six front/side start/middle/end captures and records image hashes. Both execution contexts intentionally use the same pinned Three.js decoder; they are not two distinct implementation libraries.
assessments.fit_and_visual_scope: Fit checks project actual mesh bounding-box corners and constrain their X/Y normalized-device coordinates at the sampled/captured times. For this fixed monotone translation and identity rotation, start/middle/end union bounds contain the motion and the chosen camera near/far ranges cover the geometry. Visual review remains explicitly pending_actual_image_inspection. No screenshot is treated as already reviewed.
assessments.freeze: Both source/expected file hashes match the committed freeze. Freeze time 2026-10-30T03:40:31.860934+00:00 precedes the earliest retained rehearsal input record at 03:44:25.367076+00:00, which binds the same hashes. The runner verifies the freeze before either attempt, requires operation_budget_exhausted for the default control and supplied-byte validation success for the authorized attempt.

limits: Analytic geometry/PBR comparison is performed in the native checker. Browser evidence renders those same bytes and separately compares poses; it does not repeat the analytic triangle oracle.
The 78 observations are fixed timestamp samples, not a new continuous external trajectory proof. The source pipeline independent continuous certificate check is a separate role.

This checker does not independently recompute flat face normals; topology/winding and the recorded geometry/PBR are checked. The source supplied-byte validator and actual screenshot review supply their own evidence.
The checker records and validates the supplied expected file; the evidence reviewer must match its reported hash to the committed freeze.
This review certifies no actual candidate checker execution, image inspection, complete release, live destination physics or extra engine compatibility.
binding_method: All seven reviewed source/oracle/checker/contract inputs have the same SHA-256 at the current Git commit. Review conclusions carry forward on identical inputs; no checker or browser rerun is claimed.

superseded_failed_candidate.classification: Eight failures and one error came from the changed ConstructionBudget storage; one failure came from the added top-level export target. This completed failed run remains separate evidence and is not a successful compatibility receipt.
